Tech fest

Spark 2026

Northfield College of Engineering, Pune

14 to 16 February 2027

Three days of coding, robotics, design and talks. Check the schedule, pick your events and sign up from your phone.

W-4.body:
Register

Pick an event and fill in your details. Submitting opens an email to the organisers with your details filled in. Press send in that email to finish registering.

All four fields are required. Prices and timings are in the events section.
